Grid.TextBlock:
1. (S) SITUATION:
The logistics vessel Berezina has rendezvoused near Jan Mayen Island with ammunition, fuel, and repair support for the Northern Fleet. NATO reconnaissance has located the anchorage and air strikes are expected while the task force is rearming.
2. (S) MISSION: 2.1 Defend the anchorage until resupply is complete. 2.2 {FlagshipName} must survive. 2.3 The Berezina must survive.
3. (S) EXECUTION: 3.1 Establish an air defense and surface security screen around the anchorage. 3.2 Engage hostile aircraft before they can attack the logistics vessel or the task force. 3.3 Keep the flagship and Berezina inside the protected area until the resupply event is complete. 3.4 Withdraw only after the task force has been fully rearmed and repaired.
4. (S) ENEMY SITUATION: 4.1 NATO strike aircraft are expected from bases in Iceland and Norway. 4.2 Additional reconnaissance or surface threats may be deployed against the anchorage.
5. (S) FRIENDLY SITUATION: 5.1 {TaskForceName} is responsible for local defense. 5.2 Berezina is the designated resupply and repair vessel.
6. (S) INTEL ASSESSMENT: 6.1 NATO understands that this anchorage is a critical pause in the Northern Fleet's advance and will attempt to prevent the task force from continuing. 6.2 Preserve the logistics vessel above all other non-essential targets. Without Berezina, the campaign force cannot be restored to full strength.
